question: T12 (task-9bf2dd2e94a3d03a): does a second pointer pressed and lifted during a held desktop Wave Intensity drag, after its foot fell, change the rows the drag's next growth takes; and where do the blocks below go while the drag's foot falls and grows again. On Blocks Probe at a 1600 by 1000 window, one new section per plan with a new Scrolling block and two Text blocks added after it, made on the desktop (desktop 1/2/3/26, 1/2/3/10, 1/2/3/10). 'place i r0/c0/r1/c1' moves and resizes block i by hand first. Select the Scrolling block, Edit, Design ('open'). WT, WL and WS: the Text blocks placed at 6/2/8/10 and 8/2/10/10 (CAP-T12HELD W's layout), no press, a mouse drag 0>30>...>180>...>90>...>180, a move every 300 ms, let go on 180, through one DevTools session with touch emulation on (Emulation.setTouchEmulationEnabled, maxTouchPoints 5) and a quick read 80 ms after each move. WL: half a gap after the move back to 90 a real touch tap (Input.dispatchTouchEvent touchStart, 100 ms, touchEnd) on the Wave Intensity label while the mouse still holds the range; WT: no tap (the control); WS (the editor's stage beside the frame) stopped at its tap: the desktop view leaves no such point beside the frame, so WS has no reads past 'open'. WD: the first Text block as added (1/2/3/10), the second placed at 8/2/10/10; a press on 90, then a drag 90>120>150>180>150>120>90>120>150>180 at 300 ms (written as a prediction first, predictions.txt in the lane folder). Then Escape and a press on the page (go) and Cmd+Z. Exit without saving each time. R1 ran WT, WL (WS stopped there); R2 WD, WL, WT; R3 WD.
readsAre: As CAP-T12HELD: layout of the Scrolling block and every block in its section (me: the Scrolling block; line: its drawing's height; sel: selected; kind; desktop and phone areas, top in the section and height), the section rows in the view shown, the Scrolling block's height, line (marquee and svg: top in the block and height), Undo and Redo, the panel's ranges; 'wave' is the panel's Wave Intensity value. 'inputs' holds each drag's quick reads (states: [name, { t: the page's clock, L: the layout as in reads, st: value, focus (isRange: the range has it), Undo/Redo, selected blocks, lines, focus: the focused element by tag, type, label and role }]) and its events by the page's clock from the first (log: type, ms, pointer type, pointer id, target, the range's value). 'keys' holds the arrow key reads, as CAP-T12DRAGEND's. 'tapPoint' is the tap's point and what was under it; 'touchAction' the range's computed touch-action up its parents. The read's name is the run, the plan, and the steps in order, '>' between them ('Z' is Cmd+Z, skipped when the section is back as built; 'z' always pressed).
answer: A desktop drag's foot that falls takes the blocks that start at or under the old foot up with it, as a one-step press fall does, and leaves a block that starts above the old foot. WT (R1 and R2 alike): the Text blocks at 6/2/8/10 and 8/2/10/10 go down with each growth from 0 to 180 (10/2/12/10 and 12/2/14/10, 13 rows); back down, 150 takes them to 9/2/11/10 and 11/2/13/10 (12 rows), 120 and 90 to 8/2/10/10 and 10/2/12/10 (11 rows); out again they go down with each growth, 150 9/2/11/10, 180 10/2/12/10 and 12/2/14/10, 13 rows. WD (R2 and R3 alike, as predicted): after the 90 press (1/2/5/26, the first Text block 3/2/5/10 on the foot, the second 10/2/12/10), out to 180 takes them to 5/2/7/10 and 12/2/14/10; back down the first, starting above the old foot, stays 5/2/7/10 while the second follows the foot up to 11/2/13/10 at 150 and 10/2/12/10 at 120 and 90; out again both go down with each growth, 6/2/8/10 and 11/2/13/10 at 150, 7/2/9/10 and 12/2/14/10 at 180, 13 rows.

So the growth after a fall takes every block below down by the foot's change, as before it fell: the ends that CAP-T12DRAGAGAIN s, t and u read (and the reach rule built from them) come out the same, since a block under the foot was taken up by the way back.

WL (R1 and R2 alike): a real touch tap on the Wave Intensity label while the mouse holds the range, after the foot fell, changes no rows: the drag goes on and every read after it is WT's, 13 rows at the end. The tap fires a pointerdown and pointerup (touch, pointer 2), then a mousedown, a change at 90 and a click on the label; the focus moves from the range to the panel (Block Editor Form) and stays there through the let go.
Each drag is one undo step: Escape keeps the areas; Cmd+Z gives back the state before the drag (WT and WL: the placed blocks, 9 rows; WD: the 90 press's), the next the place steps one by one.

With touch emulation on, the Redo button is not found during the drag (Redo reads null in the held reads); Undo reads on. Not read: a second pointer on the desktop stage or the page (the desktop view leaves no stage beside the frame), a second pointer held through the let go, a drag fall of more than one step between two moves, the phone view.
